note: Synthetic, non-production. Mirrors Acme\AssignmentSeed\Model\Seed\SeedData. The mp_tax_class product attribute is a global-scope select whose store-0 option VALUES are the business tax codes below. The backing eav option ids are assigned by shuffled inserts after a deleted throwaway option, so an option id is never equal to (nor ordered like) the business code and differs per environment. TaxCodeResolver maps option id to the store-0 value; correctness depends on the value being the business code.
